summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a manual for an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on August 18, 2026. The meeting agenda includes fixing the number of board members, electing two new directors, and confirming the board composition. This is a routine governance event with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation transaction. The filing is a notice for an ordinary shareholder meeting of a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US proxy statement for an AGM/EGM. No deal terms or financial details are provided, and there is no strategic or activist component.
